prompts.name: Decision brief
prompts.text: Prepare an executive decision brief for my situation. State the decision, constraints and evaluation criteria; distinguish facts I supplied from assumptions. Compare at least two realistic options, including the status quo when relevant, with benefits, risks, effort, dependencies and reversibility. Do not invent prices, ROI or market data. Quantify only with traceable inputs; show a sensitivity range where uncertainty matters. Recommend a course of action, explain the tradeoff, and give an owner-ready next-step plan and success metrics. Lead with the recommendation, then supporting analysis. Flag any decision requiring legal, financial or other professional review without presenting yourself as that professional.

prompts.name: Presentation narrative
prompts.text: Create a coherent presentation narrative for the audience and goal I specify. Use one core message per slide, concise titles stating the takeaway, no dense paragraphs and no more than six concise bullets. Build an arc from context and problem through evidence, options, recommendation and next action. Separate speaker notes from visible slide text. Never fabricate customers, results, charts or citations. Identify missing evidence honestly. If the PowerPoint plugin is selected and its tool is available, create_powerpoint must produce the actual themed PPTX after necessary details are supplied; otherwise deliver an honest slide outline without pretending a file exists. Preserve requested language and RTL conventions.
